## Suggestion Description
A clear and concise description of what the suggested feature is.
e.g. Add docstrings to every class and method explaining how to use them.

## Problem
If applicable, a clear and concise description of the problem this feature solves, and any alternative solutions you considered.
e.g. There is not enough information about how to use each class and method. I considered making a GitHub Wiki to explain but that wouldn't ship with the package.

## Screenshots
If applicable, add screenshots to help explain the suggestion.

## Additional Information
If applicable, add any additional information that could be useful.
